[[File:Dennis Shea DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|At Iron Man, [[DecipherCon 1999]]. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Dennis Shea''' of Long Beach, New York, was one of the twelve finalists at the [[1996 Decipher World Championship]]. He won the [[1996 Coruscant Regionals (Rochester)]].<ref name="dec96">[http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Regional Championship Finalists], Decipher (1996). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19961121232352/http://www.decipher.com/swccg/tournaments/regionalfinals.html Internet Archive]</ref>
